boxes.reason: Win7 32-bit, GTX 1650 on the Standard VGA stub: no OpenGL ICD, and Serious Engine 1 has no software renderer; disc_mount=false so no Join shortcut.
Title not installed (operator override "not wanted on .243"); P166 below the 233 MHz floor; no disc mounter.

summary: All 8 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) independently re-verified in the same TFE game on the dev-host server: one CRC-OK+joined pair per IP in the engine log with no drops, GameSpy 8/16 players (no bots), ~250 packets/12 s from each box, and fresh fullscreen frames of the level (7 with HUD). .186 and .243 NA. Game closed gracefully on all 8; PROCLIST shows no SeriousSam.exe; every box at its agent/chat console on the desktop.
issues: .184 check frame shows the level but no HUD in both the round check and this re-check; the server log, roster (ArchoN) and packets prove it is in the game. Cosmetic or a HUD setting, not a join failure.
lanparty on_server column reads "?" for this title because the GameSpy roster carries no IPs; the engine log is the per-box witness.
lanparty.py kill takes the game as a positional argument; the documented "--game" flag is rejected.
